description: This is a Java JUnit test source file for the class {@link ThingUpdater}. It contains unit tests that validate the behavior of the ThingUpdater actor, focusing on handling of different kinds of Thing events, policy tags, synchronization triggers, and shutdown commands.

classes.name: ThingUpdaterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the {@link ThingUpdater} actor, which handles sync and event processing for 'things' in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: setUpBase
methods.description: Sets up the actor system and test probes before each test.

methods.name: tearDownBase
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: startActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes a new ActorSystem with configuration for testing.

methods.name: shutdownActorSystem
methods.description: Terminates the ActorSystem if it is running.

methods.name: createThingUpdaterActor
methods.description: Creates an instance of the ThingUpdater actor for testing.

methods.name: createThing
methods.description: Test verifying the creation of a Thing and the generation of corresponding Metadata message.

methods.name: thingTagWithHigherSequenceNumberTriggersSync
methods.description: Test ensuring a higher sequence number tag triggers a sync process.

methods.name: thingTagWithLowerSequenceNumberDoesNotTriggerSync
methods.description: Test ensuring a lower sequence number tag does not trigger a sync process.

methods.name: policyReferenceTagTriggersPolicyUpdate
methods.description: Test that a PolicyReferenceTag with a higher policy revision triggers an update.

methods.name: policyIdChangeTriggersSync
methods.description: Test that changing policy IDs triggers a synchronization.

methods.name: acknowledgesSuccessfulSync
methods.description: Test that a successful sync is acknowledged with a StreamAck message.

methods.name: acknowledgesSkippedSync
methods.description: Test that an outdated or skipped sync is acknowledged without further action.

methods.name: shutdownOnCommand
methods.description: Test that the actor shuts down upon receiving a shutdown command.
